This vignette states the input contract for the four public analysis routes.
The first chunk runs without a model or image. The complete workflow chunks
are executable after replacing the paths with the reader's calibrated H&E
images, registered masks and licensed Virchow2 checkpoint. The package does
not distribute those third-party inputs. A frozen real-image regression with
expected hashes is in `REPRODUCE_ONE_RESULT.md`.

```{r contract}
if (requireNamespace("Bora", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stopifnot(utils::packageVersion("Bora") >= "0.2.0")
  missing_spacing <- tryCatch(
    Bora::Bora.prediction(tempdir(), output_dir = tempfile("bora-vignette-")),
    error = conditionMessage
  )
  stopifnot(grepl("Measured spacing source_mpp_xy", missing_spacing,
                fixed = TRUE))
}
```

## Prepare full-channel features

Calibrate X and Y pixel spacing from the supplied image metadata. The
reviewed tissue mask limits encoder windows to tissue; the expert class mask
is a separate fitting input. Without a tissue mask, preparation encodes the
entire image field, including empty glass-slide background.

```{r prepare, eval=FALSE}
image <- "/data/roi-a.tif"
tissue <- "/data/roi-a-tissue.geojson"
model <- "/models/Virchow2-v1"
prepared <- Bora.preparation(
  images = image, tissue_masks = tissue,
  feature_dir = "/results/roi-a-features-v1", model_dir = model,
  scales = c(1L, 2L, 4L), minimum_free_gib = 100,
  backend = "cuda", n.cores = 2L
)
```

The factor 1, 2 and 4 caches retain all 1,280 channels. The encoder needs
the separately licensed model. Use `backend = "cpu"` for CPU-only extraction;
CUDA requires an admitted GPU and CUDA-enabled PyTorch. Verify the preparation
receipt before fitting or reusing a cache.

## Fit from registered class annotations and predict

Training annotations must use the exact image coordinate frame. Zero denotes
unscored pixels. Choose channels, thresholds and penalties on training-only
folds before evaluating another image.

```{r supervised, eval=FALSE}
head <- Bora.training(
  images = image, annotations = "/data/roi-a-classes.tif",
  feature_dir = prepared, output_dir = "/results/head-v1",
  backend = "cpu", n.cores = 4L
)
result <- Bora.prediction(
  preparation = prepared, predictor = head,
  output_dir = "/results/roi-a-prediction-v1",
  source_mpp_xy = c(0.50, 0.50), # replace with measured X and Y values
  output_mpp_xy = c(4, 4), minimum_area_um2 = 2000,
  contour_sigma_um = 6, minimum_free_gib = 100,
  backend = "cpu", n.cores = 4L
)
```

Inspect the result manifest, multiclass TIFF, binary class images, source-pixel
GeoJSON and preview together. A training-image replay tests software
registration; it is not an independent accuracy estimate.

## Predict anonymous KODAMA groups jointly

With no predictor, `Bora.prediction()` pools strictly admitted tissue tiles
from all images in the preparation. Group IDs are anonymous, not tissue names.

```{r joint, eval=FALSE}
anonymous <- Bora.prediction(
  preparation = prepared, predictor = NULL,
  resolutions = c(0.5, 1, 2), output_dir = "/results/joint-v1",
  source_mpp_xy = c(0.50, 0.50), # all inputs must have this measured spacing
  minimum_free_gib = 100, backend = "cpu", n.cores = 4L
)
```

## Refine expression groups on the same section

The Seurat, Giotto or SpatialExperiment object must carry spot positions
registered to the H&E image and expression-derived cluster labels. This is
an exploratory same-section fit, not a cell segmentation or independent
anatomical validation.

```{r spatial, eval=FALSE}
spatial <- Bora.spatial(
  image = image, object = clustered_object,
  tissue_mask = tissue, output_dir = "/results/spatial-v1",
  source_mpp_xy = c(0.50, 0.50), # measured H&E pixel spacing
  coordinate_scale_xy = c(1, 1), backend = "cuda", n.cores = 2L
)
stopifnot(file.exists(spatial$mask), file.exists(spatial$geojson))
```

Use the [Benchmark 4 tutorial](https://tkcaccia.github.io/Bora-Analysis/visium/tutorial.html)
for the dataset-specific steps that create a clustered R object from Visium
data. Its historic raw-input replay is not distributed with this package.
